verses.en: This is a true saying, If a man desire the office of a bishop, he desireth a good work.
verses.pt: Fiel é esta palavra: Se alguém aspira ao episcopado, excelente obra deseja.
verses.en_web: This is a faithful saying: if a man seeks the office of an overseer, he desires a good work.
verses.en_bbe: This is a true saying, A man desiring the position of a Bishop has a desire for a good work.

verses.en: A bishop then must be blameless, the husband of one wife, vigilant, sober, of good behaviour, given to hospitality, apt to teach;
verses.pt: É necessário, pois, que o bispo seja irrepreensível, marido de uma só mulher, temperante, sóbrio, ordeiro, hospitaleiro, apto para ensinar;
verses.en_web: The overseer therefore must be without reproach, the husband of one wife, temperate, sensible, modest, hospitable, good at teaching;
verses.en_bbe: The Bishop, then, is to be a man of good name, the husband of one wife, self-controlled, serious-minded, having respect for order, opening his house freely to guests, a ready teacher;

verses.en: Not given to wine, no striker, not greedy of filthy lucre; but patient, not a brawler, not covetous;
verses.pt: não dado ao vinho, não espancador, mas moderado, inimigo de contendas, não ganancioso;
verses.en_web: not a drinker, not violent, not greedy for money, but gentle, not quarrelsome, not covetous;
verses.en_bbe: Not quickly moved to wrath or blows, but gentle; no fighter, no lover of money;

verses.en: One that ruleth well his own house, having his children in subjection with all gravity;
verses.pt: que governe bem a sua própria casa, tendo seus filhos em sujeição, com todo o respeito
verses.en_web: one who rules his own house well, having children in subjection with all reverence;
verses.en_bbe: Ruling his house well, having his children under control with all serious behaviour;

verses.en: (For if a man know not how to rule his own house, how shall he take care of the church of God?)
verses.pt: (pois, se alguém não sabe governar a sua própria casa, como cuidará da igreja de Deus?);
verses.en_web: (but if a man doesn’t know how to rule his own house, how will he take care of the assembly of God?)
verses.en_bbe: (For if a man has not the art of ruling his house, how will he take care of the church of God?)

verses.en: Not a novice, lest being lifted up with pride he fall into the condemnation of the devil.
verses.pt: não neófito, para que não se ensoberbeça e venha a cair na condenação do Diabo.
verses.en_web: not a new convert, lest being puffed up he fall into the same condemnation as the devil.
verses.en_bbe: Not one newly taken into the church, for fear that, through his high opinion of himself, he may come into the same sin as the Evil One.

verses.en: Moreover he must have a good report of them which are without; lest he fall into reproach and the snare of the devil.
verses.pt: Também é necessário que tenha bom testemunho dos que estão de fora, para que não caia em opróbrio, e no laço do Diabo.
verses.en_web: Moreover he must have good testimony from those who are outside, to avoid falling into reproach and the snare of the devil.
verses.en_bbe: And he is to have a good name among those outside the church, so that nothing may be said against him and he may not be taken by the designs of the Evil One.

verses.en: Likewise must the deacons be grave, not doubletongued, not given to much wine, not greedy of filthy lucre;
verses.pt: Da mesma forma os diáconos sejam sérios, não de língua dobre, não dados a muito vinho, não cobiçosos de torpe ganância,
verses.en_web: Servants, in the same way, must be reverent, not double-tongued, not addicted to much wine, not greedy for money;
verses.en_bbe: Deacons, in the same way, are to be serious in their behaviour, not false in word, not given to taking much wine or greatly desiring the wealth of this world;

verses.en: Holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.
verses.pt: guardando o mistério da fé numa consciência pura.
verses.en_web: holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.
verses.en_bbe: Keeping the secret of the faith in a heart free from sin.

verses.en: And let these also first be proved; then let them use the office of a deacon, being found blameless.
verses.pt: E também estes sejam primeiro provados, depois exercitem o diaconato, se forem irrepreensíveis.
verses.en_web: Let them also first be tested; then let them serve if they are blameless.
verses.en_bbe: And let these first be put to the test; then let them become Deacons if there is nothing against them.

verses.en: Even so must their wives be grave, not slanderers, sober, faithful in all things.
verses.pt: Da mesma sorte as mulheres sejam sérias, não maldizentes, temperantes, e fiéis em tudo.
verses.en_web: Their wives in the same way must be reverent, not slanderers, temperate, faithful in all things.
verses.en_bbe: Women are to be serious in behaviour, saying no evil of others, controlling themselves, true in all things.

verses.en: Let the deacons be the husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.
verses.pt: Os diáconos sejam maridos de uma só mulher, e governem bem a seus filhos e suas próprias casas.
verses.en_web: Let servants be husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.
verses.en_bbe: Let Deacons be husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their houses well.

verses.en: For they that have used the office of a deacon well purchase to themselves a good degree, and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.
verses.pt: Porque os que servirem bem como diáconos, adquirirão para si um lugar honroso e muita confiança na fé que há em Cristo Jesus.
verses.en_web: For those who have served well gain for themselves a good standing, and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.
verses.en_bbe: For those who have done good work as Deacons get for themselves a good position and become free from fear in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.

verses.en: These things write I unto thee, hoping to come unto thee shortly:
verses.pt: Escrevo-te estas coisas, embora esperando ir ver-te em breve,
verses.en_web: These things I write to you, hoping to come to you shortly;
verses.en_bbe: I am writing these things to you, though I am hoping to come to you before long;

verses.en: But if I tarry long, that thou mayest know how thou oughtest to behave thyself in the house of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.
verses.pt: para que, no caso de eu tardar, saibas como se deve proceder na casa de Deus, a qual é a igreja do Deus vivo, coluna e esteio da verdade.
verses.en_web: but if I wait long, that you may know how men ought to behave themselves in God’s house, which is the assembly of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.
verses.en_bbe: But if I am long in coming, this will make clear to you what behaviour is right for men in the house of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and base of what is true.

verses.en: And without controversy great is the mystery of godliness: God was manifest in the flesh, justified in the Spirit, seen of angels, preached unto the Gentiles, believed on in the world, received up into glory.
verses.pt: E, sem dúvida alguma, grande é o mistério da piedade: Aquele que se manifestou em carne, foi justificado em espírito, visto dos anjos, pregado entre os gentios, crido no mundo, e recebido acima na glória.
verses.en_web: Without controversy, the mystery of godliness is great: God was revealed in the flesh, justified in the spirit, seen by angels, preached among the nations, believed on in the world, and received up in glory.
verses.en_bbe: And without argument, great is the secret of religion: He who was seen in the flesh, who was given God's approval in the spirit, was seen by the angels, of whom the good news was given among the nations, in whom the world had faith, who was taken up in glory.
